function: Excluded (system): OTA personalized FL where each client's channel is a scalar fading coefficient h_{n,t} and the server receives one scalar signal: single-antenna links, no RIS (p. 5, eq. 11).
notes: PDF is the paper of the DOI (title and DOI 10.1109/TWC.2025.3573777 on p. 1). Checks 1-5 pass: research article proposing BROMO; OTA FL counts as learned; p. 1: 'leverages over-the-air computations for model aggregation' (area 7). Check 6 fails: p. 5, eq. (11) 'y(tau) = sum_n h_{n,t} x_n(tau) + xi(tau), where h_{n,t} is the channel fading experienced by client n', a scalar 'i.i.d. across clients'; p. 7: 'we employ Rayleigh fading to model the channel gain'. The paper never mentions antennas; Fig. 1 (p. 4) draws one server antenna; beamforming and RIS appear only in related work (p. 3, refs [11], [37]-[39]). Each client-to-server link is thus single-antenna at both ends with no RIS, in an area 7 work. The antenna count is implied by the scalar model, not stated in words, for the reviewer to confirm. Results are quantitative (test accuracy, pp. 8-10).
